title: Outbound host allowlist
description: Which hosts the server may send a request to. Written in this repository because FINOS publishes no control requirement for an MCP server (#270). The first three properties are the ones the CALM control-requirement meta-schema requires of every control.

control-id.description: The key of this control in the architecture file.

default-hosts.description: The hosts allowed on every deployment, as the code lists them.

configured-host-setting.description: The setting whose host is added to the allowlist at startup.

scheme.description: The only scheme an outbound document request uses.

redirects.description: A redirect to another host is not followed.
